analyze.title: Analyze my HEOR evidence or data
analyze.description: Inventory local evidence and data, clarify the estimand, then propose an auditable analysis.
analyze.prompt: Help me analyze the HEOR evidence or data in this project. First inventory the relevant local material and explain what it can support and what is missing. Then organize the evidence and data, preserve traceability, and propose auditable analysis steps. Ask me only about an unresolved decision question, estimand, method, material assumption, or interpretation that could change the result.

audit.title: Audit an HEOR model or report
audit.description: Check methods, inputs, model-result bindings, reporting, limitations, and reproducibility.
audit.prompt: Audit the current HEOR model, analysis, or report using the relevant AI4HEOR validation, reporting, reproducibility, and traceability Skills. Ask me which artifact graph to review if it is ambiguous. Separate deterministic defects from scientific judgments, bind every finding to exact local evidence, and never create Human approval or claim methodological validity.

design.title: Start a pharmacoeconomic study
design.description: Define the decision problem, conceptual model, evidence needs, and Human review points.
design.prompt: Help me start a researcher-led pharmacoeconomic or HEOR study. Start from the information I have already provided. For a named medicine, search authoritative public sources first for its identity, approved indications, dosage forms and strengths, labelled population, and comparator context; then use a form so I can select, correct, or supplement the retrieved candidates. Clarify only gaps that could materially change the study. Evidence organization, research-plan preparation, record-keeping, and checks are assistant work. Keep confirmed decisions, open questions, evidence needs, and assumptions separate. I decide scientific methods, material assumptions, evidence choices, thresholds, interpretation, and intended use.

example-cea.title: Explore an example: cost-effectiveness analysis
example-cea.description: Synthetic two-strategy cohort inputs for an auditable cost-utility workflow.
example-cea.prompt: Open and explain the built-in complete cost-utility teaching case. Treat every number as a teaching assumption, not clinical or economic evidence. Explain the decision problem, review the three-state cohort structure, reproduce the base-case cost and QALY calculation, run one transparent sensitivity check, and state the limitations and questions that still need researcher review. Do not make reimbursement, pricing, or policy conclusions.

scope.title: Frame the research question
scope.prompt: Help me frame this pharmacoeconomic or HEOR decision problem. Start from what I provide. For a named medicine, search authoritative public sources first for its identity, approved indications, dosage forms and strengths, labelled population, and comparator context; then use a form so I can select, correct, or supplement the retrieved candidates. After that, confirm outcomes, perspective, time horizon, and intended decision use. Ask only for information that would materially change the study.

evidence.title: Find and organize evidence
evidence.prompt: Help me find and organize the evidence needed for this pharmacoeconomic study. First clarify the decision problem, population, intervention and comparator, outcomes, jurisdiction, time range, and evidence gaps, then identify useful local sources and the literature, trial registries, and methods sources that need to be searched. Record search dates, sources, queries, inclusion judgments, and limitations. When confirmation is required, disclose outbound search content once before the first retrieval; proceed directly when this task is already authorized or test mode is active. You may import RIS, BibTeX, or CSL-JSON for deduplication and metadata review. For a lawfully downloadable public PDF actually used to support a claim, archive the file in the current task and record its source, retrieval date, and checksum. If I explicitly request journal full text, download only lawfully available open versions. Do not describe an ordinary search as a complete systematic review.

model.title: Design or review a model
model.prompt: Help me design or review this health economic model. Start from the decision problem and examine model structure, parameter evidence, key assumptions, uncertainty, and validation requirements. Keep calculation errors separate from issues that require researcher judgment.

deliverable.title: Analyze data or prepare a briefing
deliverable.prompt: Help me with this pharmacoeconomic or HEOR task. I can provide data, a model, a report, or briefing requirements. First inventory the available materials and expected deliverable, then propose a reviewable analysis or production path.
